summary: The worker-evidence client signing key is held by the OS credential store behind exactly one custody adapter (the secret-tool lookup in adapter/opencode/credentials.ts); the Go core keeps only public keys. The dependency is the freedesktop Secret Service standard, not any provider — gnome-keyring, KWallet, and other implementations are interchangeable without code change, and a platform port swaps the adapter alone. The installer preflight fails closed without a provider, no plaintext fallback exists, and the single-user session-readability residual is recorded rather than hidden.
title: Client signing keys live behind a single OS-custody adapter
